scope: source-qualified frozen-pack native diffuse views; no full converter publication or retail parity

gpu.shader: production native material with depth/normal prepass

regions.distance_classification: Visual scene category only; no depth buffer or numeric camera distance was measured.

sunlit_thatch.description: Central thatch roof; includes its texture and baked/shadowed strands.

shaded_wood.description: Central vertical wood wall below the roof; avoids window, beam, foliage and stone.

stone_wall.description: Right portion of central foundation; contains stone and mortar.

foreground_grass_soil.description: Foreground grass/soil mixture; does not isolate a single material.

foreground_fern.description: Foreground fern and a small amount of stone/ground behind its cutouts.

sapling.description: Sapling in front of left building; cutout leaves include wood/ground background.

distant_mountain.description: Left mountain face; no sky or tree geometry in the selected rectangle.

sky.description: Unobstructed upper sky; separate from geometry fog and material shading.

metric_domain: Final opaque captured PNG sRGB decoded to normalized linear sRGB/D65 luminance and OKLab; not pre-HDR radiance.
limits: Lighting-report preparation counts differ between runs; visible GPU mesh and shadow-caster counts match. Adaptation/preparation history is not claimed identical.
HDR adaptation/bloom/grading respond to changed scene inputs, so unmodified sky, terrain and foliage can change in the final image.
Fog-off also bypasses geometry finishing/clamps. Fog comparisons do not isolate the blend alone.
Source lighting units, noon sun direction, foliage soft response, terrain material response and final presentation remain retail acceptance gates.
